card.name: Word after stopping a drug, before MAOI
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "before" in "at least 14 days should be allowed after stopping [drug] before starting an MAOI". Also the first letter or piece of a name like Nilotinib, ZnO or co-stimulation.

modes.label: Washout sentence
modes.description: The word "before" after "stopping [drug name]" ahead of starting an MAOI antidepressant.
modes.example: at least 14 days should be allowed after stopping escitalopram tablets<< before>> starting an MAOI intended to treat psychiatric

modes.label: Inside a split term
modes.description: A middle piece of a technical term, like co-stimulation or 5-HT3.
